Topics · Is there a God?

How sure do I need to be before I believe?

Almost nothing you do rests on full proof. Certainty has degrees, even for Abraham. So how much is enough?

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمُ رَبِّ أَرِنِى كَيْفَ تُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ۖ قَالَ أَوَلَمْ تُؤْمِن ۖ قَالَ بَلَىٰ وَلَـٰكِن لِّيَطْمَئِنَّ قَلْبِى ۖ قَالَ فَخُذْ أَرْبَعَةً مِّنَ ٱلطَّيْرِ فَصُرْهُنَّ إِلَيْكَ ثُمَّ ٱجْعَلْ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ جَبَلٍ مِّنْهُنَّ جُزْءًا ثُمَّ ٱدْعُهُنَّ يَأْتِينَكَ سَعْيًا ۚ وَٱعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And [mention] when Abraham said, "My Lord, show me how You give life to the dead." [Allāh] said, "Have you not believed?" He said, "Yes, but [I ask] only that my heart may be satisfied." [Allāh] said, "Take four birds and commit them to yourself.[107] Then [after slaughtering them] put on each hill a portion of them; then call them - they will come [flying] to you in haste. And know that Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise."

Translator's notes

[107] i.e., train them to come to you on command.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:260

Translation

As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were. Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.” Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb. Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God, and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.

Romans · 4:17-21

Translation of the meaning

Translation

For they diligently search while living among his works, and they trust their sight that the things that they look at are beautiful. But again even they are not to be excused. For if they had power to know so much, that they should be able to explore the world, how is it that they didn’t find the Sovereign Lord sooner?

Original · Ancient Greek

Ἐν γὰρ τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτοῦ ἀναστρεφόμενοι διερευνῶσι, καὶ πείθονται τῇ ὄψει, ὅτι καλὰ τὰ βλεπόμενα. Πάλιν δὲ οὐδʼ αὐτοὶ συγγνωστοί. Εἰ γὰρ τοσοῦτον ἴσχυσαν εἰδέναι, ἵνα δύνωνται στοχάσασθαι τὸν αἰῶνα, τὸν τούτων δεσπότην πῶς τάχιον οὐχ εὗρον;

Wisdom · 13:6-9

World English Bible

﴿وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.

Quran · Al-Haqqah 69:51

Start with a distinction. Belief and certainty are not the same. You can believe your friend will keep a promise, and still feel your chest tighten as you wait. The first passage here records what many would be embarrassed to do. Abraham asks to be shown, and is asked if he does not believe. He says yes, and that he asks so his heart may rest. So wanting more is not the opposite of believing. Certainty, on this account, is no switch. It is something that grows.

A question for you

Which is closest to how you hold what you believe most deeply?

If you sayI know it.
ThenThen ask how it would be if it were tested. Certainty that has been tested rests differently.
If you sayI trust it, and I have doubts.
ThenThat is closer to what is told here than many people suppose.
If you sayI do not hold anything that deeply.
ThenThat is honest. What follows may still help: you act every day on less than certainty.

﴿فَبِمَا رَحْمَةٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ لِنتَ لَهُمْ ۖ وَلَوْ كُنتَ فَظًّا غَلِيظَ ٱلْقَلْبِ لَٱنفَضُّوا۟ مِنْ حَوْلِكَ ۖ فَٱعْفُ عَنْهُمْ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَشَاوِرْهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ ۖ فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

So by mercy from Allāh, [O Muḥammad], you were lenient with them. And if you had been rude [in speech] and harsh in heart, they would have disbanded from about you. So pardon them and ask forgiveness for them and consult them in the matter. And when you have decided, then rely upon Allāh. Indeed, Allāh loves those who rely [upon Him].

Translation

Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.

Original · Hebrew

בְּטַ֣ח אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־לִבֶּ֑ךָ וְאֶל־בִּֽ֝ינָתְךָ֗ אַל־תִּשָּׁעֵֽן׃

Proverbs · 3:5

World English Bible

Now the practical question. Nobody has certainty before acting. You choose whom to marry, which treatment to take, where to live, with no proof. You have reasons and you weigh them. Three things set how much you need: what is at stake, whether it can be undone, and what not deciding costs. Not deciding is also a choice. This verse gives the order: ask others, and once you have resolved, go forward and trust. It does not say wait until you cannot be wrong.

A question for you

Which of these decides how sure you need to be?

If you sayWhat is at stake.
ThenThen big questions deserve more care, and they do not go away if you leave them.
If you sayWhether it can be undone.
ThenThen begin with what can be undone. An honest look commits you to nothing.
If you sayWhat waiting costs.
ThenThat is a cost many people leave out. It is no reason to hurry. It is only part of the sum.

Original · Hebrew

קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הוָה לְכָל־קֹרְאָ֑יו לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִקְרָאֻ֣הוּ בֶאֱמֶֽת׃

the Psalms · 145:18

World English Bible

So what about the largest question? You need no certainty before doing anything. There is a first step small enough to take in doubt: to look honestly, and to ask. A person can say, into the quiet: if You are there, show me. That commits no one. The first verse here says those who strive are shown the ways. It puts the walking before the arrival. The reply is fair: people tend to find what they expect, so this cannot serve as proof. It is an invitation, not a result.

A question for you

What is the smallest honest step available to you, if you want one?

If you sayTo keep reading and asking.
ThenThen that is the step, and it needs nothing else.
If you sayTo ask, in my own words, whether anyone is there.
ThenThat is yours to do, and no one here will see it.
If you sayTo do one good thing I have been putting off.
ThenDo it for its own sake, if you like. It is good whether or not you are sure.
If you sayNothing today.
ThenThat is fine. The question will keep.
